name: navigation-menu
useFor: Use for a site's main navigation when a section needs a panel of links (Product, Use cases, Resources). Give each NavigationMenuItem a value, put rows of NavigationMenuLink inside NavigationMenuContent, and divide groups with ds-rule-y under a ds-label heading. A plain link in the bar takes navigationMenuTriggerStyle(). Let the menu span the header so its sheet spans the page.
constraints: An icon that moves on hover
Panels that need scrolling on desktop
title: Navigation Menu
description: The site's header nav: bare 14px graphite triggers with a 12px chevron that turns over, a compact hexagon of the hover wash behind the open one, and a full-width square sheet of the ground under the bar, ruled off by the quiet line. Links are rows of a 20px glyph, a 14px medium label and a quiet line, the row under the pointer on the paper; groups sit under Kode Mono eyebrows divided by dashed rules.
